VaultAutoSyncToggle.autoBackupIsOnButThis: Auto backup is on, but this vehicle could not be identified. Click to pick which vehicle you are working on in the vault.
VaultAutoSyncToggle.hasNoSavedHistorySoSaves: "{{name}}" has no saved history, so saves would start a new vehicle entry. If it is one of your saved vehicles, click to link it in the vault.
VaultAutoSyncToggle.notBackedUpClickToSet: Not backed up. Click to set up online backup in the vault.
VaultAutoSyncToggle.thisSaveIsSnapshottedAndPushed: This save is snapshotted and pushed to your repository automatically. Click to turn off.
VaultAutoSyncToggle.automaticBackupIsOffClickTo: Automatic backup is off. Click to back up and sync after every save.

VaultSyncBadge.nothingHasBeenCopiedOnlineYet: Nothing has been copied online yet.
VaultSyncBadge.savesStayOnThisComputerUntil: Saves stay on this computer until you set it up.
VaultSyncBadge.backupIsOnLastCopiedOnline: Backup is on. Last copied online {{v1}}.
VaultSyncBadge.backupIsOnButNothingHas: Backup is on, but nothing has been copied online yet.
VaultSyncBadge.backupIsOffYourSavesStay: Backup is off: your saves stay on this computer only.

VaultView.ardudeckBacksUpYourParameterSnapshots: ArduDeck backs up your parameter snapshots, missions and areas to an online repository. Everything keeps working offline; sync happens when you ask for it. Two ways to connect:
VaultView.easiestArdudeckCreatesAPrivateRepository: Easiest. ArduDeck creates a private repository for you. GitHub's approval page asks for repository access in general (that is how GitHub permissions work); ArduDeck only touches the one vault repository.
VaultView.noApprovalPageCreateAToken: No approval page. Create a token yourself (a fine-grained one limited to a single repository gives ArduDeck access to nothing else) and paste it here.
VaultView.chooseOnlySelectRepositoriesAndGive: (choose "Only select repositories" and give Contents read and write), or read
VaultView.advancedIAlreadyHaveARepository: Advanced: I already have a repository (GitHub, GitLab, self-hosted)
VaultView.pointArdudeckAtAnyExistingEmpty: Point ArduDeck at any existing empty repository over HTTPS. SSH URLs are converted to HTTPS automatically. The token needs read and write access to that repository (GitLab tokens: set username to "oauth2").
VaultView.createAnEmptyRepositoryOnGithub: Create an empty repository on GitHub
VaultView.setItToPrivateDonT: (set it to Private, don't add a README).
VaultView.orPickOneOfYourExisting: Or pick one of your existing repositories...
VaultView.existingRepositoryItsHistoryIsKept: Existing repository (its history is kept; only possible while this vault is empty)
VaultView.parametersAreStillDownloadingFromThe: Parameters are still downloading from the vehicle. Open this snapshot again once the download finishes.
VaultView.noLiveParametersLoadedConnectThe: No live parameters loaded. Connect the vehicle to compare and restore.
VaultView.perUnitCalibrationExcludedFromRestore: Per-unit calibration - excluded from restore by default
VaultView.thisSnapshotBelongsToRestoreOnly: This snapshot belongs to {{ownerName}}. Restore only writes to the vehicle it came from; set "Working on" to {{ownerName}} if this is that aircraft.
VaultView.thisSnapshotWasTakenFromBut: This snapshot was taken from {{snapshotFirmware}}, but the vehicle is running {{liveFirmware}}. Parameter names do not carry across flight stacks.
VaultView.backupAndHistoryForSettingsMissions: Backup and history for settings, missions and survey areas ·
VaultView.everythingHereIsSavedOnThis: Everything here is saved on this computer only. Turn on online backup to keep a copy off the machine and open the same missions and areas on another computer.
VaultView.snapshotsGoToThisVehicleAuto: Snapshots go to this vehicle. Auto detect uses the board id and profile.
VaultView.alreadySnapshottedThisVehicleUnderAnothe: Already snapshotted this vehicle under another name? Link it so history continues there.
VaultView.thisVehicleIsConnectedRightNow: This vehicle is connected right now
VaultView.simulatorSnapshotsKeptSeparateFromReal: Simulator snapshots, kept separate from real aircraft
VaultView.saveTheCurrentlyPlannedMissionInto: Save the currently planned mission into this site
VaultView.saveTheSurveyPolygonsOnThe: Save the survey polygons on the map as this site's boundary
VaultView.theVaultKeepsSafeCopiesOf: The vault keeps safe copies of your drone's settings, missions and survey areas, so you can always see what changed and go back.
VaultView.connectYourDroneAndPressSnapshot: Connect your drone and press "Snapshot vehicle params". Every setting is saved. Do it before and after you change anything.
VaultView.flyingWorseAfterAChangeOpen: Flying worse after a change? Open an old copy, see exactly which settings are different, and put them back with one click.
VaultView.connectAFreeGithubAccountAnd: Connect a free GitHub account and your copies are backed up to the cloud and shared with your other computers.
